payload.rationale: Implements AASHTO LRFD Section 10.7 and FHWA GEC 012 static axial compressive and uplift resistance checks for single driven piles in cohesive (Tomlinson alpha) and cohesionless (beta) soils. This closes a critical PLE Geotechnical and Structural exam gap covering deep foundation side friction, tip resistance, and resistance factor limits.
